Welcome to All in One Accessibility screen reader. To start the All in One Accessibility screen reader, press 'Ctrl + /'. This shortcut activates the screen reader to help you navigate and interact with the content.

Blind profile activates features such as:

  • Stop Animations

Visually impaired profile activates features such as:
  • Stop Animations
  • Readable Font
  • Big White Cursor
  • Text Magnifier
  • High Saturation
Color blind profile activates deuteranomaly color blindness. Other color blindness adjustments can be found within the 'color-blindness' settings.
  • Deuteranomaly
Dyslexia profile activates features such as:
  • Stop Animations
  • Dyslexia Font
Cognitive learning profile activates features such as:
  • Stop Animations
  • Reading Mask
  • Text Magnifier
Seizure epileptic profile activates features such as:
  • Stop Animations
  • Low Saturation
ADHD profile activates features such as:
  • Stop Animations
  • Low Saturation
  • Reading Mask
